scientific.integrity: The source Sadam recurrence is specialized only by choosing the explicitly permitted memoryless parameters and a scalar positive quadratic. The resulting one-dimensional map is derived exactly and the transition is proved analytically rather than inferred from finite simulation.
limitations: No claim for nonzero moment memory, stochastic gradients, or coupled multidimensional dynamics.
The supercritical two-cycle claim is local, not a global basin classification.

title: Memoryless Sadam has a sharp softplus flip boundary
